report_title: # P0035 ARC12 Shared-Background Odd-Panel All-Training Transfer-50 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive fresh-transfer packet measures the P0034 shared-background odd-panel compatibility vocabulary on a newly frozen filename-only 25 ARC-AGI-1 plus 25 ARC-AGI-2 all-training cohort. The roster was committed at eed44c9300b15756e156632afaff0563f2e6f97f before any selected task grid was parsed, visualized, scored, or used for further operator design; selection used only benchmark labels, split names, filenames, and opaque source-byte checksums. It excludes every historical import, P0013/P0022/P0026/P0029/P0032 transfer roster, and P0014/P0016/P0018/P0020/P0023/P0027/P0030/P0033 development roster; P0031 reused P0030 and P0034 reused P0033 and are therefore excluded. No fresh 25-task ARC-AGI-2 evaluation-split roster remains after prior disjoint measurements, so this packet is explicitly all-training-split rather than falsely claiming the former mixed-split protocol. Relative to P0034's frozen controller, only the corpus-callosum color-6 SVG palette changed to correct visual contrast; all answer-selection source files and the generic operator vocabulary are byte-identical. The live controller receives only each task's visible demonstrations and test input. It receives no task ID, cohort metadata, GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or test output before committing a complete grid. This fresh result cannot retune the frozen controller or its vocabulary. Any positive result is limited all-training-subset task-level transfer evidence, not an ARC-AGI-1 or ARC-AGI-2 solver claim.

implementation_reference.comparison_boundary: P0034 is exposed same-cohort development evidence on a different cohort. Its 4/40 score is implementation provenance only and is not a denominator or statistical baseline for this fresh all-training-split transfer packet.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: P0034's exposed development evidence informed the frozen generic vocabulary, but no selected P0035 task payload or target was available during that work. The controller implementation imports, parses, calls, and receives none of the GT feature records or GT solver code.

synthetic_contract.coverage: The synthetic contract proves dynamic horizontal/vertical rederivation with changing shared backgrounds and refuses tied masks and nonunique shared backgrounds.
